indicator_definition: Net official development assistance (ODA) provided by donor countries as a percentage of gross national income (GNI). The internationally agreed target is 0.7% of GNI. Data compiled by the OECD DAC and Eurostat.
rationale: ODA is a key source of development finance for lower-income countries. Progress means an increasing ODA-to-GNI ratio among donor countries.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled by the OECD Development Assistance Committee (DAC) and published by Eurostat. Covers bilateral and multilateral flows. Published annually.
indicator_name: Official development assistance as share of gross national income
graph_title: Official development assistance as share of gross national income
